summary: HDFC Bank fell ~3% on phased MSCI weightage-increase news, dragging Nifty ~90 points of its fall; Bank Nifty -750. Speaker rejects Hindenburg-report link since other stocks did not fall. Nifty closed ~24,150, near lower end of 24,000-25,000 range; FII-DII tug of war continues.

events.claim: HDFC Bank fell ~3% on 13 Aug 2024 after MSCI decided to increase its weightage in two installments instead of one; it alone contributed ~90+ of Nifty's points lost
Bank Nifty fell ~750 points (intraday high-to-low and close) on 13 Aug 2024
FIIs sold ~1.25 lakh crore since January 2024, matched roughly by DII buying
Hindenburg's 10 Aug 2024 report on the SEBI chief had minimal market impact; Adani stocks actually rose that day

lessons: Before blaming headlines, check index internals - a single heavyweight can account for nearly the whole index move.
A support tested repeatedly (24,000) weakens with each test; closing near the range low after a rejection is a warning, not relief.
quote: If Hindenburg is the reason, all the stocks should fall - but more than 90 points of the Nifty fall came only because of HDFC Bank.

summary: ECB cut rates but with hawkish tone; US struggled. GIFT Nifty only -20/25. Focus on June 9 government formation and who becomes finance minister; advice: no weekend positions. FII selling June 6 near ~8,000 crore. RBI policy seen dovish non-event. Views: buy dips, sell far-OTM puts, 22,000-24,000 range for 3 weeks; also ITC Hotels demerger and Bajaj Housing Finance IPO notes.

events.claim: ECB cut interest rates on 6 June 2024, its first cut, but accompanied by hawkish comments that dented US markets
FII selling on 6 June 2024 was close to ~8,000 crore, nearly matching the June 4 election-day selling
India VIX fell ~50% in three trading sessions after the election-day spike
ITC demerging hotels: 1 ITC Hotels share for every 10 ITC shares; Bajaj Housing Finance IPO seen as value-add for Bajaj Finance

lessons: Event gaps destroy stop-losses - hedge or adjust instead of stopping out; skip carrying positions into event weekends.
Far out-of-the-money puts bought with a buffer after panic offer asymmetric risk-reward (21,000PE still ~30-70 rupees post-crash).
Diversify capital like a business: keep FD/gold as reserve funds to stabilise a trading business when drawdowns hit.
quote: Market can take positive things, market can take negative things, but market cannot take uncertainty.
dup_flag: continues 6-7 June FM-appointment uncertainty theme; overlaps with 2298/2299a
leaks: 'my workshop'/'keeping certain things for my workshop'

summary: US PPI better than expected, US and Asian markets up; GIFT +40-50. Expiry day with both Nifty and Bank Nifty expiring - volatility expected but small gaps harmless to hedged sellers. HDFC Bank ADR rose overnight despite its -3% fall in India - short-covering possible. HDFC Bank + Reliance ~25% of Nifty weight. View: Nifty closes above 24,000; DIIs defending 24,000; unlikely above 25,000 till December.

events.claim: US PPI data (13 Aug 2024) came better than expected, driving US markets higher
HDFC Bank ADR closed green overnight (13 Aug) despite the stock falling 3%+ in India on 13 Aug
HDFC Bank and Reliance together carry about 25% weightage in Nifty

lessons: An index heavyweight's ADR moving opposite to its Indian price overnight flags short-covering potential the next session.
Expiry-day gaps of 50-100 points do not hurt hedged option sellers - only large moves do.
Microcap/smallcap 10-15x retail portfolios mean FII selling in large caps can coexist with a resilient index.
quote: HDFC Bank and Reliance - these two stocks have about 25% weightage in Nifty. If these two do badly, Nifty has a problem.
leaks: 'sponsored by a digital data exchange' (Delta garble)

summary: Remarkably flat expiry: Nifty +4/5 points, Bank Nifty -100. ICICI Bank selloff was the biggest index drag; TCS+Infosys added ~40-45 points and saved Nifty. Bulls defended 24,000 again. FII sold 2,600 crore, DII bought 2,200 crore; FIIs ~30,000 crore sold in August alone, ~45,000 crore since the 23 July budget. Nifty ~7% off highs; VIX -4%+. US CPI in line; India on holiday next day.

events.claim: FIIs sold ~30,000 crore in August 2024 month-to-date and ~45,000 crore since the 23 July budget - roughly a third of their year's selling in under a month
US CPI (August 14, 2024) came in line with expectations, no major reaction
Nifty had consolidated between 24,000-25,000 for 5-7 weeks and sat near the lower end of that range

lessons: Repeated tests of a support weaken it - the tin-sheet analogy: enough hits and it breaks.
Offsetting heavyweight moves (IT up vs banks down) can neutralise an index - read contributions, not just levels.
Pace matters more than level: when FIIs front-load a quarter's selling into weeks, caution is warranted even if price holds.
quote: The more you hit a tin, the more it weakens - finally in one hit, it will break.

summary: Post-oath-ceremony reality check; GIFT -50/55. Focus on FM portfolio announcement: recounts 31 May 2019 - Nifty -3% and Bank Nifty ~1,000 points in minutes when the FM appointment hit, recovering same day. June 3/4: +9% rally then -9% crash; stop-losses destroyed by event gaps. VIX bands framework: below 15 bull, 15-30 volatile, above 30 eventual decline. OI: 24,000CE max resistance; 23,000 straddle ~600 points; Fed meeting and CPI this week.

events.claim: On 31 May 2019 around 11:30am, Nifty fell more than 3% and Bank Nifty ~1,000 points within minutes on the FM appointment news, recovering by close
Nifty fell more than 9% intraday on 4 June 2024 election-results day and recovered most of it within three sessions
India VIX crashed from above 32 to below 16 within days of the June 4 election result
Modi 3.0 oath ceremony held 9 June 2024; FM portfolio announcement was the last major uncertainty

lessons: Event risk is gap risk: stop-losses cannot protect through a 3% minutes-long gap - hedge or stand aside.
VIX bands are a regime map: under 15 = stable/bull, 15-30 = volatile, above 30 = eventual decline.
Buy on rumor, sell on news: the pre-event rally is the trade; the post-event session rarely follows through.
quote: Within few minutes Nifty fell more than three percent... Few minutes later the news came - the finance minister had been appointed.
leaks: FM-appointment speculation and minister-criticism passage (political opinion - exclude per policy; keep market-reaction facts)

summary: Markets consolidated till 2pm then sold off ~100-150 points despite FII +2,600 crore and DII +2,700 crore - retail was the seller. Portfolio announcement delayed beyond 24 hours, first time in history; coalition friction gossip; FM speculation persists. Retail framed as increasingly smart: sold the fake exit-poll rally (June 3), bought the June 4 crash. Tax reality (LTCG/STCG hikes) capped upside; India's valuation 2-2.5x China's.

events.claim: On 10 June 2024, FIIs (+~2,600 crore) and DIIs (+~2,700 crore) were both net buyers yet Nifty closed lower - retail selling implied
Union cabinet portfolio announcement was delayed beyond 24 hours after the 9 June oath - described as unprecedented
Nifty recovered more than 2,000 points from the 4 June low by 10 June

lessons: When FII and DII both buy and price still falls, retail is the seller - flow attribution beats headline flow numbers.
Markets can absorb good or bad news; what they cannot absorb is unresolved uncertainty.
Coalition maths - not election wins - set the market's ceiling in June 2024; expectations of tax hikes capped rallies.
quote: Nifty has already shot up more than 2,000 points from the June 4 low - markets cannot keep going higher day after day.
leaks: political names and coalition gossip (Suresh Gopi, Annamalai, Purandeshwari, Ajit Pawar) - exclude political opinion per policy

summary: FM reappointed - markets not expected to react violently: markets do not react twice to the same news (COVID wave-2 analogy). Warning that capital-gains/FPI taxes will rise eventually. VIX expected below 15 = bull-market confirmation. Bank Nifty swung 400-500 points intraday. Range: 22,500-23,500 near term; sold 24,000CE @11 and 22,200PE @17; sell puts with buffers below supports; carry only Dec call-ratio (buy 22,000CE, sell 25,000CE) through the weekend.

events.claim: Nirmala Sitharaman reappointed finance minister in June 2024; the speaker predicted markets would not react violently since the appointment was anticipated
India VIX fell ~50% over three sessions post-election and was expected to drop below 15

lessons: Markets do not react violently to the same news twice - anticipation defuses repetition (COVID wave-2 precedent).
Certainty itself is bullish: an expected minister with heavy opposition is less dangerous than a surprise one.
Option sellers never sell at the support - buffer by a few hundred points because views go wrong.
quote: Markets will not be reacting twice for the same news.

summary: Audio podcast from a hill station (leak). After India's local holiday, two days of global cues compress into one session: US CPI in line + strong retail sales sent global markets up; GIFT indicated ~180 gap-up; call sellers from 14 Aug at risk. Banking weak despite low inflation. View unchanged: 24,000-25,000 consolidation until expiry; upcoming triggers - state election announcements and a Fed 50bp cut in September. Late-series time decay favours writers; sell calls only at/above 25,000.

events.claim: US retail sales (15 Aug 2024) came in strong, adding to in-line CPI and driving global markets up
Fed expected to cut ~50 basis points in September 2024
15 August was an India-only holiday, compressing two days of global movement into one Indian session

lessons: After a local holiday, two days of global movement arrive at once - keep positions light through holiday gaps.
The last two weeks of a series give the fastest time decay - the option seller's structural advantage.
Sell calls into gap-ups only at or above major resistance (25,000+), never inside the range.
quote: When there is a local holiday, we need to factor in two days of global cues on one day.
leaks: 'a place called Harsley Hills near Madhanapalli in Andhra Pradesh... 280 kilometers from Chennai' (location)

summary: Huge session: Nifty +~400 with a 300-point gap-up, 200-point fall, then ~350-point recovery (700-800 point intraday swing). Closed decisively above 24,500, at the midpoint of the 24,000-25,000 range. US stabilising; September 50bp Fed cut expected. Upcoming: state elections and US election = volatile run to December; expects both 25,000 and 24,000 to be tested before December. FII and DII turned buyers; retail now sides with DIIs against FIIs.

events.claim: Nifty rallied ~400 points on 16 Aug 2024, closing decisively above 24,500 with a 700-800 point intraday swing after the holiday
Fed rate cut of ~50 basis points expected in September 2024

lessons: Post-holiday sessions deliver compressed global moves - plan for exaggerated ranges, not normal ones.
When retail stops siding with FIIs and backs domestic liquidity, flow wars resolve upward.
Two-way event calendar (state + US elections) means the run to December stays volatile even in uptrends.
quote: There may be a point at which there will be a selling exhaustion by the FIIs - and 25,000 can be visited again.

summary: Nifty futures fell ~200 points from intraday high after 2pm; Reliance weak, banks unimpressive, FMCG sold. FM reappointment confirmed. India VIX fell ~10% in a day to below 15 - a >50% collapse from June 4's 30+. Short straddles earned ~100 points (~5%) in one session on a flat close. Gradual moves, no sudden 'injection' spikes - ideal for writers. FOMC ahead; FII data pending. June series turning good for option writers.

events.claim: India VIX fell ~10% on 11 June 2024 to below 15, down more than 50% from above 30 on 4 June
All 23,000-23,300 short straddles gained ~100 points (~5%) on 11 June despite a flat close

lessons: VIX collapse converts flat closes into straddle profits - theta plus vega both pay.
Gradual price movement without sudden spikes is the option seller's ideal regime; spike-free days are the harvest.
When institutions and retail both turn euphoric, retail fading the move is historically the smarter side.
quote: The India VIX has fallen almost 10% - that is more than a 50% crash in just the last few trading sessions.

leaks: 'my son has made another 30 lakh rupees profit' (family + P&L claim)

summary: Nasdaq/S&P record highs ahead of CPI+FOMC; Apple +7% on AI announcements; GIFT flat after overnight recovery. FII small sell, DII +3,000 crore yet Nifty -200 after 2pm: retail selling again. India becoming a retail-ruled market like Japan; DII money flows via mutual funds into mid/small caps, leaving large caps (ICICI 6 months flat, Kotak 5 years flat) behind. Bank Nifty expiry today; CPI evening. People selling 23,000PE and below; 23,600CE overhead; weekly settle expected 23,000-23,600.

events.claim: Apple rose more than 7% to a 52-week high (10-11 June 2024) on AI software announcements
Nasdaq and S&P 500 closed at record highs on 11 June 2024
ICICI Bank had gone nowhere in ~6 months and Kotak Bank ~5 years despite index highs (mid-2024)

lessons: DII money arrives through mutual funds and lands in mid/small caps - large-cap stagnation despite index highs is structural, not a glitch.
Post-2020, retail's contrarian record has been better than institutions' - respect the retail flow.
Expiry-week theta is fast: sell puts below supports (with buffer) and calls below resistances, sized for the range.
quote: Since 2020 it is the retail people who have been proving right, whereas the institutions have never been right.

summary: Asia recovered after early weakness; GIFT +80. Nifty inching toward filling the 24,720 gap from the 5 Aug crash; earlier gaps on 2 Aug after the first-ever 25,000 close. FII turned buyer Friday but one-day buys are unreliable. DIIs bought ~1-1.25 lakh crore since January with ~5% cash left. September Fed 50bp cut seen driving ATHs; October/November elections the trouble window. Ideas: Dec call ratio (buy 25,000CE, sell 2x26,000CE; ~100/share max loss) or Dec 25,000 straddle. Nifty futures premium unusually low (20-30 vs usual ~150).

events.claim: Nifty gapped down from ~24,720 to ~24,400 on 5 August 2024 (yen-carry crash day) leaving an unfilled gap
Nifty closed above 25,000 for the first time on 2 August 2024, then fell with two ~300-point gap-downs
DIIs bought close to 1.25 lakh crore since January 2024 while mutual funds still held ~5% cash

lessons: Unfilled gaps act as magnets: price gravitates to fill them, then often stalls.
Never trust a single day of FII buying - check for sequence, not snapshot.
Call-ratio spreads (buy 1 near strike, sell 2 higher) cap worst-case loss at the net debit while monetising a capped bull view.
quote: Don't be misguided by one day of FII buying - they will buy one day, and the next day they will start selling.

summary: Nifty spot crossed all-time high intraday; futures closed 23,399.95 (1-2 point discount - premium wiped out). Fourth consecutive day of 2pm selling pressure near 23,400-23,480. FII -3,000 crore and DII -500 crore (both sold) yet market resilient; Bank Nifty underperformed (no ATH while Nifty made one). Author's own Bank Nifty 50,000 short straddle (July series, 3,000 qty/~200 lots) up ~15 lakh. IT and broader markets outperformed; MF money favouring mid/small caps. Nine sessions left in June; consolidation 23,000-24,000 expected.

events.claim: Nifty spot hit an all-time high intraday on 12 June 2024; futures closed at 23,399.95, at a 1-2 point discount to spot
FIIs sold ~3,000 crore and DIIs ~500 crore on 12 June yet the index held near highs
Nifty made a closing ATH while Bank Nifty remained below its own high - bank underperformance mid-2024

lessons: A level rejected four times in a row becomes weak - each failed defense raises breakout odds.
Futures discount after premium wipeout signals aggressive short positioning into strength.
Straddles pay on intraday chaos even when the index goes nowhere close-to-close.
quote: Every time it closed below 23,400 - today 23,399.95 - there is good selling at 23,500, but the more times it tests, the weaker that resistance becomes.
leaks: 'my son has made... 30 lakh rupees profit' + '50,000 short straddle... 15 lakh rupees profit' (family + personal P&L)

summary: GIFT +150 faded to +80 at open, then sold into: private banks fell, PSU banks rose (reports of FM meeting PSU bank chiefs), IT/metals higher - a diversion day. Nifty futures closed exactly 24,590 for a second straight day. Unfilled gaps at 24,720 and 25,000 remain targets. OI: 24,600 straddle (~200 points) implies 24,400-24,800; Bank Nifty expiry Wednesday - sellers active at 50,000PE/51,000CE and 50,500 straddle (~500 points). Week range 24,100-24,800; month 24,000-25,000.

events.claim: PSU banks rallied on 19 Aug 2024 on reports of a meeting between the finance minister and PSU bank chiefs while private banks fell
Nifty futures closed at exactly 24,590 on both 19 and 20 Aug 2024
Bank Nifty 50,500 straddle traded ~500 points into the Wednesday expiry

lessons: Big gap-ups get sold into - fade euphoric opens rather than chase them.
Straddle sellers who reserve capital for adjustments survive violent days; full-capital intraday traders do not.
Two identical closes mark equilibrium - the range edges (24,400/24,800) become the tradeable boundaries.
quote: I am not a big fan of big gap ups - usually a big gap up will be sold into.

summary: India CPI lower than expected; US CPI also soft - Nasdaq/S&P record highs; GIFT ~+100 at prior day's high. All political and economic events for the week now done. Structure: first two weeks of a series are data-volatile; last two weeks trend as writers enjoy gamma. Honeymoon period with the new government; taxes will still rise (middle-class framing; Dubai aside - leak). 23,400CE saw huge OI addition - a gap-up forces shorts to cover. Range shifts to 23,000-24,000; technical retest-of-June-4-low hopes dismissed. TA is a guideline, not a golden rule.

events.claim: India CPI (released 12 June 2024) came lower than expected; US CPI also softer than expected
Nasdaq and S&P 500 hit fresh record highs on soft US CPI (12 June 2024)
23,400 call saw large OI addition on 12 June - heavy call writing at that strike

lessons: Sell calls into gap-ups when the gap-target strike carries heavy fresh OI - forced covering fuels the move.
Technical analysis is a guideline, not a golden rule; blindly expecting a retest of lows fails more often than not.
Taxes only go up - build after-tax expectations into strategy returns.
quote: Technical analysis can only be a guideline; it cannot be the golden rule.

summary: US 8-day win streak paused; GIFT +40/50 but below yesterday's high - bullish confirmation only above prior highs. 40-50 point gaps near expiry are absorbed by time value; 150-200 points is what scares straddles. MF inflows = bull market; 10 IPOs this week - primary market euphoric; Zomato block deal (3,000-5,000 crore) absorbed easily. Three resistances layered: 24,700 (gap), 24,800 (first-session close), 25,000 (gap). FII sellers again after a one-day buy. Nifty closed at 19 Aug level = July 17 close: a month of going nowhere; September breakout expected on Fed cut; Bank Nifty 50,000-51,000 tight range into expiry.

events.claim: ~10 IPOs launched in the week of 19 Aug 2024 - primary market at peak activity
Zomato block deal worth ~3,000-5,000 crore around 20 Aug 2024 absorbed without index damage
S&P 500's 8-day winning streak ended 19 Aug 2024

lessons: Bull markets are intraday-hostile: 2003-07 style index gains still bankrupted intraday traders through volatility.
An IPO flood plus retail euphoria is a late-cycle marker, not a buy signal.
Layered resistances (unfilled gap + prior high-volume close + upper gap) define where call-selling is safe.
quote: Nifty has not gone anywhere from July 17 to August 19 - a month of going up, coming down, going nowhere.

summary: Nifty up 200+ intraday; Bank Nifty +600 crossing 51,000 before a last-45-minute 250-300 point slide dragged Nifty below 24,700. The 24,720 gap filled comfortably then stalled. Call writers at 24,500-24,650 stopped out (unwinding); 24,700PE added huge OI - a floor signal. FII data distorted by the Zomato block deal. Range 24,400-24,800; month target 25,000; an ATH by month-end would not surprise. Mumbai workshop announcement (leak).

events.claim: Nifty filled the 24,720 gap on 20 Aug 2024 then closed slightly below it after a late Bank Nifty-led slide of 250-300 points
Bank Nifty crossed 51,000 intraday on 20 Aug before collapsing in the last 45 minutes
Zomato block deal made that day's FII cash data unrepresentative

lessons: Gap-fills magnet price to the gap, then often exhaust - plan exits at the fill, not beyond it.
Late-session institutional selling after a strong day says do not chase strength into the close.
Fresh put OI stacking just below price marks where sellers feel safe - a short-term floor.

FII -3,000 crore, DII -500 crore: both sold. Bank Nifty kept underperforming; FMCG sold; the day's selling came in the morning (institutional tell) instead of after 2pm (retail tell). Author's July Bank Nifty 50,000 straddle ~15 lakh profit (leak). Honeymoon period; taxation watch; consolidation 23,000-24,000.

events.claim: Nifty closed at 23,399.95 on 13 June 2024 - futures at a 1-2 point discount to spot after the premium was wiped out
FIIs sold ~3,000 crore and DIIs ~500 crore on 13 June 2024

lessons: Futures premium collapse to discount = shorts pressing into strength; watch for the squeeze when it reverses.
Timing diagnoses the seller: morning selling is institutional, after-2pm selling is retail.
A futures discount at index highs signals caution even when the chart looks bullish.
quote: The selling came in the morning itself - if selling comes after 2pm it is the retail people; in the morning, institutions.

events.claim: Apple overtook Microsoft to become the world's most valuable company in June 2024
A TCS block deal occurred around 4,042 rupees and the stock struggled below 4,000 afterwards (mid-2024)
India VIX fell ~10% one day and ~6% the next during the June 2024 post-election week

lessons: At low IV, naked selling is structurally poor - combine buys and sells so a violent move cannot hurt.
Pre-holiday sessions see position squaring concentrated in the last hour - time your entries around it.
Monthly OI has thinned because everyone trades weeklies - monthly strikes matter less than they used to.

summary: S&P consolidated after its streak; GIFT -20/30. FII -1,500 crore vs DII +2,200 crore: 'as long as DIIs pump money, no significant correction' - Japan/US fell >10% in their scares while India fell <4%. SEBI finfluencer rules complaint: broker ads allowed on YouTube while influencers cannot discuss brokers.

events.claim: Nifty did not close below 24,000 between 27 June and 20 Aug 2024 - about 8 weeks of holds
India VIX closed below 14 (20 Aug 2024) - a low-volatility regime
During the Japan-carry scare of early August 2024, US/Japan markets fell more than 10% while India fell less than 4%

Consolidations resolve by 8-12 weeks; calendar the resolution window instead of predicting the direction.
Low-VIX smoothness is the seller's adjustment window - the edge is time to react, not the premium size.

events.claim: Nifty decisively closed above 23,400 on 14 June 2024 after four failed attempts, confirming breakout
GIFT Nifty indicated a 120-130 point gap-up on 18 June 2024

Post-event digestion is when markets trend - position after the data clears, not during it.
Directional ratio trades are acceptable if sized small and paired with a pre-planned adjustment routine.

SEBI was reportedly planning to raise option-seller margin requirements and shift exchanges to flat broker fees (June 2024 reports)
India VIX below 13 on 18 June 2024 after falling since 5 June

Margin hikes on option sellers pass through to buyers as higher premiums - regulation shifts who pays, not who bears risk.
Governments time unpopular news for strong markets, when a 5-10% fall barely registers.

events.claim: Nifty's intraday all-time high was ~25,078 and closing ATH ~25,020 (August 2024) - the 25,000-25,100 resistance zone
FIIs sold ~800 crore while DIIs bought roughly four times that on 21 Aug 2024
FMCG and pharma indices hit all-time highs (21 Aug 2024), both up 8-10% in a month; TCS rose from ~3,800 to ~4,500 in two months
Sun Pharma rose ~10-11x from ~100 (2008) to ~1,100+ (2014) - the defensive-stock template through the Lehman era
Fed chair speaks at Jackson Hole on 23 August 2024 - a 50bp-cut signal is the market's hope

lessons: When DIIs buy at all-time highs instead of dips, liquidity is euphoric - corrections arrive violently, not gradually.
Defensive outperformance (FMCG/pharma at highs while cyclicals lag) is the smart money's late-cycle rotation tell.
Fresh put OI below an untested level signals conviction floors - the crowd has pre-positioned its support.
quote: Markets are not just optimistic, they are euphoric - and when the correction comes, it is going to be brutal.
leaks: 'I have given an interview to... a television channel' (media self-reference)

summary: Audio-only (travel for son's marriage parties - leak). Yesterday: Nifty flat but Bank Nifty violent - 700-800 up, 400-500 down, then 1,000+ points up intraday; intraday straddle sellers with 40-70 rupee stops were destroyed. A polarized tape: every index down except IT (slightly) and Bank Nifty (strongly). HDFC Bank ~300 off its swing low near ATH; when IT catches up, Nifty heads to 24,000. FII+DII both bought ~7,500 crore (~$2bn) in a day. FIIs buy high/sell low lately; after five selling months, 2-3 buying months could take Nifty to 24,000-25,000. Buy dips; sell 23,000PE on 250-300 point dips; premiums thin - shift to July series (IT results + budget). OI: 23,000PE and 24,000CE heavy = the range; 23,500 straddle only for daredevils; trade Nifty, not sectoral indices.

events.claim: FIIs and DIIs together bought ~7,500 crore (about $2 billion) on 19 June 2024
Bank Nifty swung 700-800 points up, 400-500 down and 1,000+ points up within 19 June 2024's session
Jane Street and Millennium hedge funds were speculated to be back active in Indian markets (June 2024)

lessons: Size intraday straddles for the index's true volatility, not the last week's calm - Bank Nifty's 1,000-point days kill 50-rupee stops.
Polarized tapes (one sector up, everything else down) are flow-driven, not macro - trade the flow, not the story.
When FII and DII buy together, dips are shallow and brief - buy-the-dip beats shorting strength.
quote: People do intraday short straddles with 40-70 rupee stop losses - when the market moves 1,000 points up and down so easily, it was a very difficult day.
leaks: son's marriage travel ('visiting our close friends and relatives houses') (family)
'Jane Street and Millennium... back to the market' (fine as market content)

summary: A quiet, classic expiry: after the gap-up was sold in 15 minutes, Nifty traded within ±20-25 points all day - ideal for option sellers. Bank Nifty crossed 51,000 again (its normal volatility); no 'Jane Street effect' today. IT, FMCG, healthcare, consumer durables and pharma all hit ATHs - defensives lead while Bank Nifty sits ~5% under its high; that catch-up alone is ~1,000 Nifty points, making 26,000 a December possibility (euphoric stage). A put calendar taken two days ago is +5% in five sessions. 24,800 straddle (~300 points) implies 24,500-25,100. Month started 24,400 +400 on day one; Fed speech tomorrow then a quiet US week.

events.claim: IT, FMCG, healthcare, consumer durables and pharma indices hit all-time highs on 22 Aug 2024 while Bank Nifty remained ~5% below its own high
Nifty traded within ±20-25 points through 22 Aug 2024 expiry after an early gap-up fade
Bank Nifty crossed 51,000 again on 22 Aug 2024

lessons: Quiet expiries are the straddle seller's harvest: low realised range plus fast theta.
Defensive-sector ATHs while the index heavyweight lags is the classic late-cycle rotation signature.
Index catch-up math: a lagging heavyweight's 5% gap equals ~1,000 points of stored index upside.
quote: Today was a fantastic day for option sellers - plus or minus 20 to 25 points only, all day.
